title: Estuate Software
description: Designed using a progressive two-phase strategy. Incorporates pre-fabricated structural modules for the upper floors alongside energy-efficient western sun shading elements to mitigate solar heat gain.

title: Boys Campus, GSIS
description: Part of the extensive phase-2 expansion. The master planning carefully integrates educational, residential, and athletic infrastructure onto steep hillside contours while optimizing movement corridors.

title: Nandeesh Residence
description: A spacious 5-bedroom home designed on Scandinavian minimalistic ideals. Simple contours, neutral palettes, and an abundant flow of natural light deliver spatial tranquility.

title: Tata Cancer Center
description: Part of the distributed cancer care initiatives across India. This facility incorporates state of the art surgical, medical, and radiation oncology support zones, optimized for patient recovery.

title: Classroom Block, SNU
description: A 6-story university block welcoming users with an asymmetric open-air meeting courtyard, designed to form a contemporary institutional identity.

title: Zion Hills Villa
description: A signature model villa featuring panoramic views of the adjacent golf fairways, with a layout that blends internal lounge zones with the surrounding green landscape.

title: Crescent House
description: A monolithic concrete residence folding around a mature tamarind tree. Raw board-formed concrete surfaces dialogue with light-and-shadow pockets, evoking visual simplicity and silent massing.

title: Eco-Corridors Sanctuary
description: A reforestation and eco-tourism reserve balancing low-impact bamboo visitor structures with native vegetation paths, incorporating macro-scale stormwater bioswales.

title: Monolith Studio
description: A workspace designed on structural essentialism. Large seamless quartz worktables anchor the room, contrasted by brushed stainless steel detailing and raw acoustic panels.
